title: Fed and OCC Quiz U.S. Banks After $6.3 Billion Binance Hack
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Fed and OCC Quiz U.S. Banks After $6.3 Billion Binance Hack Federal Reserve and OCC supervisors contacted U.S. banks this week to check for vulnerabilities after the Binance hack. This post Fed and OCC Quiz U.S. Banks After $6.3 Billion Binance Hack first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
